references.text: Gideon also asks for a sign from God here to confirm that it is truly the Lord speaking to him.
The continuation of Gideon's prayer for a sign with the fleece, showing his need for confirmation from God.
Moses also asks God for signs when he is called to deliver Israel from Egypt.
God offers King Ahaz to ask for a sign, which shows that God is willing to confirm His promises.
Elijah prays that God would reveal Himself as the true God and save Israel, similar to Gideon's prayer for deliverance.
Jesus speaks of people's desire for signs and points to the sign of Jonah as the only sign that will be given.
